commits.title: Restore Django startup after dev merge
commits.before_text: Unresolved markers in the merge commit prevented Django from importing its models. VS Code F5 and container startup validation failed.
commits.after_text: The repair resolves all 79 conflict blocks across 26 files, preserves the intended changes, and restores Django startup. The runtime image excludes the one-off database scripts.
